cards.example_en: I felt ashamed after laughing at my friend's mistake.
cards.example_zh: 嘲笑朋友的错误后，我感到很羞愧。
cards.explain_zh: 常作表语：be ashamed of或be ashamed to do。

cards.example_en: Students should never feel ashamed to ask for help when they struggle with difficult subjects.
cards.example_zh: 学生在学习较难的科目遇到困难时，绝不应因求助而感到难堪。

cards.example_en: Graduates who found new businesses can create employment opportunities and introduce innovative services to local communities.
cards.example_zh: 创办新企业的毕业生可以创造就业机会，并为当地社区引入创新服务。
cards.explain_zh: “创立”的过去式是founded；“找到”的原形是find。

cards.example_en: She writes a blog about growing vegetables at home.
cards.example_zh: 她写一个介绍在家种菜的博客。
cards.explain_zh: 一篇博文叫a blog post；blog常指整个博客。

cards.example_en: Cool water relieved my thirst after the long walk.
cards.example_zh: 走了很长一段路后，凉水缓解了我的口渴。
cards.explain_zh: 口渴常说be thirsty；thirst for表示对……的渴望。

cards.example_en: I packed two shirts for the weekend at Grandma's house.

cards.example_en: We shared three sandwiches under the tree at noon.

cards.example_en: We put four chairs around the kitchen table.

cards.explain_zh: four是基数词；表示顺序“第四”用fourth。

cards.example_en: Dad bought five apples for our picnic on Saturday.

cards.example_en: My little sister is seven and starts school this autumn.

cards.example_en: Count to ten before you answer your brother in anger.
cards.example_zh: 先数到十，再在气头上回答你弟弟。
